statement: In a distributive lattice $(L, \approx, \wedge, \vee)$, the meet operation distributes over the join on both sides: for all elements $x, y, z \in L$, $x \wedge (y \vee z) \approx (x \wedge y) \vee (x \wedge z)$ (left distributivity) and $(y \vee z) \wedge x \approx (y \wedge x) \vee (z \wedge x)$ (right distributivity), where $\approx$ is the underlying equality of the lattice.
